summary: You can now change, copy and manage Conditional Access policies and their groups from one place, safely and with a full record.

new.title: Edit an adopted Conditional Access policy
new.text: You can change any part of an adopted policy in a simple form, with names you can type. You see every change before it is sent, and you approve it with a reason.

new.title: Clone a policy into a new one
new.text: Clone creates a new policy from an adopted one with your changes. The copy always starts switched off, so you move it through the stages when it is ready.

new.title: Edits stay safe and recorded
new.text: Only SuperAdmins can edit or clone, and only by their own action. Changes are refused if the policy changed meanwhile or would lose the break-glass exclusion, and every change is recorded.

new.title: New Groups page for Conditional Access
new.text: See every group your policies use, whether it exists, its members and whether its rule is right. SuperAdmins can create missing groups, fix rules and change pilot or exclude members.

new.title: Stage moves also update pilot groups
new.text: Moving a policy to a new stage now widens or pauses its pilot group as needed. If the group cannot be set, the policy is left unchanged. Get started can also create a missing group.
new.action: Run the install once more so the engine gets the two new group permissions; Get started, step 1, shows when they are granted.

fixes.title: Settings buttons stay on screen
fixes.text: On a wide window, the Settings page now lines up each setting so Save and More info stay visible.

fixes.title: Private installs update more reliably
fixes.text: An install on a private network now sets up its build resources the way Azure accepts, and finishes a replacement left over from an earlier run.
